question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

Others looked at the issue __________.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"differently"** means in a way that is not the same as another or as before. (अलग ढंग से)

 
 
• **Example: **She looked at the problem **differently** and came up with a unique solution.
 
 
 
• **"Differently"** is an adverb form of the adjective **"different,"** and it is used to describe how an action is performed. (अलग ढंग से)
 
 
• **Example: **Others looked at the issue **differently**, coming up with various solutions.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Difference **(अंतर): A point or way in which people or things are dissimilar.

 
 
• **Example:** The difference between the two proposals was significant.
 
 
 
• **Different **(अलग): Not the same as another or each other.
 
 
• **Example: **We had different opinions on the matter.
 
 
 
• **Differential** (अंतर): A difference between amounts of things.
 
 
• **Example:** There was a significant differential in their salaries.
